title: EXCLUSIVE: Maybelline New York’s Iconic ‘Maybe She’s Born With It’ Tagline Gets a Revamp
summary: For the first time since the slogan was introduced in 1991, Maybelline is adjusting it “in the direction of what women need today,” said global president Sandrine Jolly.
